_comment: Parity fixture for act-number normalisation. Read by BOTH
and, when DATABASE_URL is set, by the same suite against npa.norm_number()
in Postgres. The SQL function is the definition; the TS port exists for
offline use. A change to one that is not made to the other fails here.
'norm' is the expected npa.norm_number() output. 'note' says why the case
is in the list, so a future edit cannot quietly delete a regression guard.
